title: Lipschitz compactly supported fields with |G| ≤ 1 are admissible for |Dv|(W)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every set W ⊆ ℝⁿ, every v : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every K-Lipschitz G : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ (K ∈ ℝ≥0) with compact support, tsupport G ⊆ W and ‖G(x)‖ ≤ 1 for all x: ENNReal.ofReal(∫_W v·div G) ≤ bvVariationOn v W, where div G = Chapter02.euclideanDivergence G and the integral is the Bochner integral over volume.restrict W.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (v : Rn n → ℝ) (G : Rn n → Rn n) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ W → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in W, v x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence G x) ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn v W
